findings.evidence: Host tools. Bash below means the host's shell tool; AskUserQuestion (with multiSelect) means its structured-question tool; Read means its file reader.
findings.fix: Move the tool-name glossary to references/wizard-flow.md and keep only the no-tool fallback (number the options, wait, never answer for the user) in SKILL.md; record the moved paragraph.

findings.evidence: The NEVER list has no Gotchas heading, and the landmines that justify it (guessed codex ids, raw 200-id lists, proposals before unmatched confirmation) sit in Step 2.2 rather than beside the rules.
findings.fix: Add a short Gotchas section after NEVER that restates those three landmines with the reason each fails at dispatch, and point each one at the step that prevents it.

findings.evidence: catalog.md says Step 2.2 reuses the catalog path via cli-model-selection.md item 1, but wizard-flow.md loads that file only when a preferred runtime has no models list or the catalog printed unmatched candidates.
findings.fix: Change the parenthetical to 'wizard-flow.md step 3 reuses the same path', and keep the cli-model-selection.md pointer only on the unmatched-candidate branch.

findings.evidence: catalog-report is offered twice as equal commands (--detect and --runtimes-json) with no default for the normal setup run.
findings.fix: Make --runtimes-json the default (it uses the snapshot Step 1 saved) and say to use --detect only when the owner asks for a live listing after the snapshot.

findings.evidence: edge-router-alias-assumed asserts only 'If the proposal shows an alias group', so a run that never shows the group still passes.
findings.fix: Change the expected output and assertions to require the printed alias group, labelled 'assumed: router-env alias naming', unranked and unscored, for the lane in evals/files/router-alias/lanes.md.

findings.evidence: 20 queries, 10 should-trigger and 10 should-not, but no train/validation split.
findings.fix: Split the file into a fixed train set of about 12 and a validation set of about 8, each mixing positives, negatives and near-misses.

findings.evidence: Today only Claude Code selects a model per call (its sonnet, opus, haiku and fable aliases)
findings.fix: Replace the four alias names with 'the short aliases detect-current-runtime prints for this host' and tell the agent to offer only those printed values.

findings.evidence: herdr-names --runtime copilot is a fixed command with no instruction to read the command's own --help or a dated vendor source.
findings.fix: Add one line: before the first herdr-names run, read its --help and use only the flags it prints.
